purpose: Evaluate whether version 0.4 reduces consequential interpretation and evidence-basis failures while retaining extraction coverage and defensible alternatives.
comparison: Whole frozen 0.3 and 0.4 coding workflows on identical fresh source packets within each episode; no claim that prose changes alone cause any difference.

selection.unit: Complete contribution episode with prespecified available contextual and dated sources
selection.main_sample: Three episodes, one from each metadata stratum: merged contribution, closed unmerged contribution, and procedure-related title. Candidate size range 1000 to 12000 source-text characters before common supplements.
selection.ranking: SHA256 of the literal protocol_id, a vertical bar, and canonical repository PR identifier; ascending lexical digest within each stratum. Assign procedure-title stratum first, then remaining merged or closed-unmerged strata. One record cannot occupy two strata.
selection.supplement_rule: Preserve complete corpus-supplied bodies, comments, reviews, and inline comments; add only directly referenced guidance pinned to a recorded revision, outcome metadata, and patches relevant to selected proposition identity. Freeze all supplements before dispatch and give identical content to both conditions.
selection.exclusion: Exclude every previously examined episode and any episode whose content was inspected to develop 0.4, including all Round 12 sources and worked examples. Build and verify a complete exposure inventory before selection.
selection.known_inventory_status: The package supplies a partial known-exposure list. The complete earlier project inventory and candidate corpus are not included in this development release. Do not claim unseen selection until the inventory is completed and hashed.
selection.higher_level_challenge_set: If the three metadata-selected cases provide no substantive higher-level claims, report that gap. A separate, explicitly purposive challenge set may then be designed and frozen under a separately versioned addendum. Do not silently add favorable cases or pool them with the main sample.

execution.context: Fresh context for every annotation; no parent history, earlier annotations, or other coder output.
execution.model: Same actually available primary configuration across the paired comparison; record exact configuration and limits exposed at dispatch. Any cross-model extension is a separate condition.
execution.order: Interleave 0.3 and 0.4 within each episode and rotate which condition goes first across episodes. Freeze the explicit schedule before dispatch.
execution.source_review: Use two fresh review contexts with the same source-review instructions; no agreement scores or condition names. Review all records, including unanimous claims. Resolve differences against sources and preserve unresolved findings.
execution.unavailable_metadata: Provider snapshot, seed, sampling parameters, token use, and cost remain null when not exposed. Do not infer speed or cost superiority.

primary: Source-supported interpretation-changing error groups by episode and condition
Evidence-basis error groups by episode and condition
secondary: Repair burden from first to final output
outcomes.standing_crosswalk: Analyze documentary coverage, recognition, application, and challenge against sources in both versions. Do not treat the former single standing label as numerically equivalent to the new profile.
outcomes.denominators: Field agreement uses one-to-one matches and reports excluded groups and source clustering. Error groups are descriptive judgments, not independent accuracy observations.
outcomes.no_posthoc_rewrite: Preserve pre-reconciliation agreement, original annotations, and frozen test criteria. A criterion revised after observing fresh results requires another version.

readiness.mechanical: All final outputs satisfy their assigned schema and exact-source checks, or failures are explicitly counted.
readiness.substantive: No unresolved source-supported overclaim may remain in an adopted downstream conclusion concerning proposition identity, authority, recognition, time, application, or governance level. Resolve the evidence, narrow the claim, or retain it as unresolved.
readiness.coverage: Check all source entries and material qualifiers; abstention or stricter classification must not conceal lost relevant propositions.
readiness.interpretation: A higher agreement score alone is not a pass. Report condition-specific strengths, failures, and alternatives. The small sample supports bounded comparison, not full-corpus validation.
